LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Are pigeons real? Are they part of a government conspiracy? Are they spying on us?

Yes. To all 3. 

As a small, but esteemed member of the top secret Paranormal Examination & Kontainment unit, it’s your job to locate, identify, neutralise and extract dangerous anomalies that have begun to terrorise New Squawk City.

The chaos within the city is growing constantly and naturally, as a Pigeon, it’s your job to maintain the status quo. Gear up with specialised, government issue tools, take to the streets, locate anomalies, neutralise them and deliver them for analysis. Use your daily earnings to improve your abilities, buy better tools, rest up and then head back out for another day of anomaly hunting!

You and up to 3 other feathered agents are now responsible for keeping this city safe, the cryptids contained, your role within the government secret and most importantly, meeting your quotas.

P.E.K. doesn’t tolerate slackers, so hit your targets or it’s back to a life of eating trash and being chased by children. 

In Pigeon Simulator you will see:

Numerous different anomalies to defeat, capture and extract for research.
Sophisticated pooping, cooing and flying systems.
Peak, specialized, government issued anti-anomaly equipment.
Deep upgrade system to take your pigeon from a street rat to a sky king.
